column1: # Each line, in every file of fixtures/parity/ (one per noun, design §8.4),
# is run by scripts/go-library-goldens.sh against Go ctxloom
# by the Rust acceptance test (library_parity.test.rs) against this binary.
# Source of every line: the Go feature named in the id's group comment.
# ctxloom-project bundle, adapters/content's tree fixtures, a premised bundle
# Configuration: schema 8 and older, layering, strict decode (cli/config.feature, fault_tolerance.feature)
# Nothing there: no content directory at all, and an empty one (empty_listing_hint, cli/agent.feature)
# No project here (configload/appdir.go: no .ctxloom up the path, so the home's config alone)
